structures.name: Outer Guard Tower
structures.description: The first tower on each Human lane. Cheapest to break and the one that opens the lane.
structures.notes: The Middle Guard Tower behind it stays invulnerable until this one falls. Its own team can attack it at any health — the lane towers and the Castle are the exceptions to the rule that stops a team from damaging its own buildings above 50% health.

structures.name: Middle Guard Tower
structures.description: The second tower on each Human lane. Same reach as the outer one, with more health and damage behind it.
structures.notes: Invulnerable until the Outer Guard Tower falls, and the Inner Guard Tower behind it stays invulnerable until this one goes down. Its own team can attack it at any health.

structures.name: Inner Guard Tower
structures.description: The last tower before the Castle. Hits harder than the lane towers and, since 1.3.9, reaches just as far.
structures.notes: Rebuilt in 1.3.9 on the Guard Tower, replacing the Arcane Tower that stood here and taking Feedback with it. Invulnerable until the Middle Guard Tower falls, and the Castle stays invulnerable until this one goes down. Its own team can attack it at any health.

structures.name: Side Guard Tower
structures.description: Stands at the corners of the Human base and cannot be attacked. Anything it reaches dies to one hit.
structures.notes: Four per team, two above the top lane and two below the bottom one, flanking the base. It carries no health or armor figure here because nothing can bring it down.

structures.name: Castle
structures.description: The Human base. Destroy it and the Undead team wins the game.
structures.notes: Invulnerable until the Inner Guard Tower falls. Its own team can attack it at any health.

structures.name: Fountain
structures.description: Stands behind the Human base among the shops. Restores health and mana to its own team, never to the enemy, and shoots back at whatever comes close.

abilities.name: Healing Ward (Fountain)
abilities.description: Restores 3.5% of maximum hit points per second to friendly units within 500 range.

abilities.name: Fountain of Mana
abilities.description: Restores 3.5% of maximum mana per second to friendly units within 500 range.

structures.notes: Both teams field the same building. Its attack carries no cooldown of its own — the map switched the attack on and left the field at zero — so it fires as fast as the animation allows and no damage per second can be given.

structures.name: Outer Spirit Tower
structures.description: The first tower on each Undead lane. Cheapest to break and the one that opens the lane.
structures.notes: The Middle Spirit Tower behind it stays invulnerable until this one falls. Its own team can attack it at any health — the lane towers and the Black Citadel are the exceptions to the rule that stops a team from damaging its own buildings above 50% health.

structures.notes: Invulnerable until the Outer Spirit Tower falls, and the Inner Spirit Tower behind it stays invulnerable until this one goes down. Its own team can attack it at any health.

structures.name: Inner Spirit Tower
structures.description: The last tower before the Black Citadel. Hits harder than the lane towers and, since 1.3.9, reaches just as far.
structures.notes: Rebuilt in 1.3.9 on the Spirit Tower, replacing the Nerubian Tower that stood here and taking Frost Attack with it. Invulnerable until the Middle Spirit Tower falls, and the Black Citadel stays invulnerable until this one goes down. Its own team can attack it at any health.

structures.name: Black Citadel
structures.description: The Undead base. Destroy it and the Human team wins the game.
structures.notes: Lost Frost Attack in 1.3.9, so both bases now hit the same way. Invulnerable until the Inner Spirit Tower falls. Its own team can attack it at any health.
